phrases: set up a new world record
创造新的世界纪录
She set up a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
她在百米赛跑中创造了新的世界纪录。
have great difficulty in doing something
在做某事方面有很大困难
He had great difficulty in controlling the car.
他在控制汽车方面有很大困难。
be disappointed to learn
失望地得知
I was disappointed to learn that the concert was cancelled.
我失望地得知音乐会取消了。
reach speeds of over
达到超过...的速度
The train can reach speeds of over 300 kilometers per hour.
这列火车可以达到每小时300公里以上的速度。
following in someone's footsteps
追随某人的脚步；继承衣钵
She followed in her mother's footsteps and became a doctor.
她追随母亲的脚步，成为了一名医生。
drive at over
以超过...的速度驾驶
The racing car drove at over 200 miles per hour.
这辆赛车以超过每小时200英里的速度行驶。
a few days later
几天后
A few days later, we received the good news.
几天后，我们收到了好消息。
be specially built for
为...专门建造
This car was specially built for the racing competition.
这辆车是为赛车比赛专门建造的。
although...+主语+动词
虽然...但是...
Although it was raining, we still went out.
虽然下雨了，但我们还是出去了。

grammar.f: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.d: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作，或称为"过去的过去" 用于描述两个发生在过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时
ex: He was disappointed because his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
他很失望，因为他的平均速度是299英里/小时。
A few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
几天后，有人告诉他一个错误已经犯了。

grammar.k: although 引导的让步状语从句
grammar.f: Although + 主语 + 动词(从句), 主语 + 动词(主句)
grammar.d: although引导让步状语从句，表示"虽然...但是..." although引导的从句放在句首，修饰主句的转折关系。注意：although和but不能同时使用
ex: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car.
虽然坎贝尔达到了每小时304英里以上的速度，但他很难控制汽车。

grammar.f: 主语 + be + 过去分词 (+ by + 动作执行者)
grammar.d: 当动作的承受者作为句子的主语时，使用被动语态 用于强调动作的承受者或不知道动作执行者时
ex: Bluebird had been specially built for him.
蓝鸟号是专门为他建造的。
He was told that a mistake had been made.
有人告诉他犯了一个错误。

patterns.p: 主语 + was/were + 形容词 + to do something
o: Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
坎贝尔失望地得知他的平均速度是299英里/小时。
im: She was happy to hear the good news.
她高兴地听到这个消息。
I was surprised to see him there.
我很惊讶在那里见到他。

patterns.p: 主语 + set up + a + 形容词 + world record + 时间/地点
o: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
1935年9月，他在犹他州的博纳维尤盐沼创造了新的世界纪录。
im: She set up a new world record in the Olympic Games.
她在奥运会上创造了新的世界纪录。
He set up a new record at the age of 25.
他在25岁时创造了新的纪录。

patterns.p: although + 主语 + 动词..., 主语 + 动词...
o: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car.
虽然坎贝尔达到了每小时304英里以上的速度，但他很难控制汽车。
im: Although it was very cold, we went swimming.
虽然天气很冷，我们还是去游泳了。
Although she studied hard, she failed the exam.
虽然她学习很努力，但她考试没通过。

patterns.p: Following in someone's footsteps, 主语 + 动词
o: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son also set up a world record.
多年后，继承父亲的衣钵，坎贝尔爵士的儿子也创造了世界纪录。
im: Following in her teacher's footsteps, she became a professor.
继承她老师的衣钵，她成为了一名教授。
Following in his brother's footsteps, he joined the army.
追随他哥哥的脚步，他参了军。
